name: mealog
description: 우리가 함께한, 맛있었던 기억 - 스마트 식사 타임라인

scripts.cap:sync: node scripts/select-cap-config.js staging && npm run copy:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:production: node scripts/select-cap-config.js production && npm run copy:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build:staging: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/build-android.js assembleStagingDebug
scripts.cap:build:production: npm run cap:sync:production && node scripts/build-android.js assembleProductionDebug
scripts.cap:sync:bundled: node scripts/select-cap-config.js staging.bundled && npm run copy:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build:bundled: npm run cap:sync:bundled && node scripts/build-android.js assembleStagingDebug
